item.title: Registration Now Open for The Lawn & Landscape Business Builders Summit
item.description: Registration has officially opened for the Lawn & Landscape Business Builders Summit. This year’s event will again take place at the Loews Vanderbilt Hotel in Nashville, Tenn., May 7-8, 2025.

item.title: Recycling Today’s Battery Conference Heads to Nashville in 2025
item.description: The Recycling Today Media Group is excited to announce its 2025 Battery and Critical Metals Recycling Conference will be at the Loews Vanderbilt Hotel in Nashville, Tennessee, June 9–10.

item.title: Registration Open for 2025 Lawn & Landscape Technology Conference
item.description: Registration has officially opened for the 2025 Lawn & Landscape Technology Conference, the green industry’s only conference dedicated solely to technology for landscape contractors, lawn care professionals and industry decision-makers. This year’s event heads back to Las Vegas, taking place at Caesars Palace July 23-25, 2025.

item.title: GIE Media Horticulture Group wins five regional 2025 Azbee Awards of Excellence
item.description: The Azbees, one of the most competitive awards programs for B2B media, highlight editorial, online and design excellence.

item.title: Lawn & Landscape brings home 21 TOCA Awards
item.description: The magazine’s editorial, graphics and marketing team received six first-place awards

item.title: GIE Media’s Horticulture Group honored with national awards for editorial and design excellence
item.description: The GIE Media Horticulture Group has earned eight national industry awards.

item.title: Registration Now Open for 2026 Lawn & Landscape Business Builders Summit
item.description: Registration is now officially open for the Lawn & Landscape Business Builders Summit. Now in its third year, this 1 ½ day event will again take place at the Loews Vanderbilt Hotel in Nashville, Tenn., May 20-21, 2026.

item.title: Garden Center magazine announces dates and location for 2026 Garden Center Conference & Expo
item.description: Garden Center magazine's Garden Center Conference & Expo, the independent garden center industry’s most anticipated event, heads to Nashville in 2026.

item.description: The announcement coincides with the brand’s 30th anniversary.
